name: orb_atr_scaled_v1
mechanism: NIFTY's 09:15-09:30 window is the overnight information absorption period; large institutional participants hold back directional orders until the range crystallises. When NIFTY breaks above the range high with expanding volume and ADX-confirmed directionality, the previously-withheld institutional TWAP flow begins executing and creates a sustained 15-25 spot point extension within the next 60-120 seconds. The KEY innovation over standard ORB: targets and stops scale with ATR(14 min at 5s) rather than the ORB range width. On high-volatility NIFTY mornings (wide ATR), the setup warrants wider stops and targets; on quiet days, tighter management avoids giving back small gains. This decouples the entry signal (ORB, about price structure) from trade management (ATR, about current volatility regime).
core_signal_oneliner: 15-minute ORB breakout with ADX trend filter and ATR-adaptive stop/target sizing based on current volatility regime
